items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: I got paid, you know, Griffin got paid, Phil Thomas got paid and Jody Jerry got paid

ctx.x: He said, 'Man, I got a job for him out of Chicago, and I can't find him.' So Tom looks at me and I look at Tommy, and Tommy said to him 'You know Wilbur Ware?' -- and he says, 'Yeah, man, I'm from Chicago; I know Wilbur. Do you know where I can find him?'

And Tom says, 'But you do know Wilbur, don't you?' and he said, 'Yes, I know him'; and he said, 'Well, what you want with him, man?' and he showed me this placard that he's got with my name all over it and Johnny Griffin and Jody Christian and Phil Thomas on drums, and the next one was gonna be Sonny Rollins with the same rhythm section, and he said, 'Man, if you know where he's at, please tell him' and I said, 'Well, man I am Wilbur Ware.' But all I could do was just laugh, and Tommy said, 'Yeah?' and 'You knew…
Maybe you could talk; before you get in to that too much, maybe you can talk about this Sonny Rollins date that was at the Vanguard; that's an important date.
